name: @dreamteamer/setup
description: A one-release shim: dt-setup doctor and setup hand over to dt status and dt setup; link/unlink preview a local clone of dreamteamer-modules.

dreamteamer.title: Setup
dreamteamer.description: Since dreamteamer 0.47 the board is the engine's (`dt status`, `dt doctor`) and the repair `dt setup <unit>`; this package is a one-release shim onto them, and keeps `dt-setup link <clone>` / `unlink`, which preview a local clone of dreamteamer-modules in place of the published modules.
